task_and_failure: A local job must reuse its successful immutable planner checkpoint after native cancellation during finalization, without repeating checkpoint execution.
discovery_provenance: Existing recovery catalog gap and previously reviewed native Dagu lifecycle evidence; no new discovery-list adoption.
license_and_compatibility: Existing Dagu 2.16.6 GPL-3.0 native executable; Python standard library only. Darwin 25.5.0 arm64.

baseline_and_candidate.baseline: Restart the whole deterministic workflow; not executed in this experiment.
baseline_and_candidate.candidate: Retry only finalize from the retained successful checkpoint using native Dagu.

predeclared_metrics.quality_rule: Native aborted then succeeded under the same run ID; checkpoint count exactly one and hash unchanged; all 12 tests before and after; observed owned processes retired.
predeclared_metrics.usage_rule: No model call in this fixture; observed local model categories zero. Total coordinator task usage is outside scope and unknown; no savings claim.

runtime_and_platform.isolation: New private task directory, DAGU_HOME, configuration and minimal child environment. No global services, scheduler, credentials or environment changes.

failures_and_skips.reason: Native validation rejected the initial explicit entrypoint name before any DAG execution; earlier freeze and failure hashes are retained.

limitations: No model calls were made by this deterministic fixture. Agent-session resume, provider cancellation, disconnect and host restart recovery remain unqualified.
The visible 12-test synthetic planner oracle was already accepted. This is no real-application or hidden-test benchmark and has no external effects.
Observed process retirement covers sampled owned process identities and the retry finalizer; it is not an exhaustive operating-system process audit.
Raw native histories and private generated paths remain in the isolated task directory; public hashes prove byte identity, not independent observation truth.
Native aborted history is preserved even though the cancelled start command returned exit zero. Expected cancellation is part of the successful recovery procedure.
No matched model baseline, total coordinator usage coverage, savings claim, general worker recovery or cross-host restore acceptance.

One pre-execution schema failure and the initial native success are retained with earlier runner hashes; the frozen accepted variant is the final source. No quality or efficiency comparison is made between these adapter variants.

rollback: Preserve task evidence, then retire only the task-owned workspace and optional scoped WSL executable; no global configuration or service was installed.
next_decision_changing_test: A separately authorized native-agent interruption with explicit session/account boundaries and artifact reconciliation; not implied by deterministic Dagu retry.
